category: 'Mineral building products' / 'Mortar and Concrete' / 'Screed dry mortar'
Use advice for data set: This dataset refers to the production of 1 kg synthetic resin screed. The density is 1800 kg/m³. Thermal conductivity 1.2 W/mK, the compressive strength is 25 N/mm² depending on the specific structure. The data set can be used approximately for the estimation of bulk densities of 1600 - 2000 kg. The data set represents a cradle to gate inventory. It can be used to characterise the supply chain situation of the respective commodity in a representative manner. Combination with individual unit processes using this commodity enables the generation of user-specific (product) LCAs. | |
Technical purpose of product or process: Synthetic resin screed is used as leveling and base layer in the floor structure. Fast readiness for covering (after approx. 24 hours). | |
General comment on data set: This data set has been modeled according to the European Standard EN 15804+A2 for Sustainable Building. Results are depicted in modules that allow the structured expression of results over the entire life cycle. | |
Description: Product system depicted except for a few missing processes / flows. Technological, temporal and geographic representativeness partly given. | |
Technology description including backgro: Synthetic resin screed is a mixture of sand and epoxy resin in a mass ratio of about 25:1. The use of epoxy resin has a significant impact on the LCA results. In the disposal phase, a manual dismantling (no loads) is assumed in module C1. The transport in module C2 to the landfill site takes place with a truck (50km). In C3, if relevant, a packaging with PE foil is taken into account (for example, for mineral fiber products. 0.0125 kg foil per kg of discarded material). In module C4 the average landfill emissions corresponding to the product (reference country Germany) are shown. The use of landfill gas is not taken into account.
